items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Stock May Trade At A Cash Flow Premium While Earnings Look Fair
items.summary: Cisco Systems stock has delivered strong multi year gains, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares now sit close to an intrinsic value estimate rather than standing out as a bargain.
